# Copilot Instructions

## Translation reference priority

When working with Traditional Chinese (`zh-tw`) translation terminology in this repository, always use the translation reference in the following priority:

1. First, try to read the latest public translation table from:

   https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SyuanTsai/Warhammer-40-000-DARKTIDE-Mods/main/Referneces/Translation.md

2. If the public raw GitHub URL cannot be accessed, use the local fallback file:

   Referneces/Translation.md

3. Use the translation table as the terminology reference for Warhammer 40,000: Darktide terms.

4. Do not rewrite unrelated translation content unless explicitly requested.
